items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006

ctx.x: It was cheaper, and it was Blue Chip Bourbon as I recall. And in that band we had Emerson Brown of course, Derry Hall, let’s see Derry Hall was playing trombone in that band then. And the band played an exhausting gig at the Deke House and we all fell asleep under the piano. And we awoke several hours later, and I knew they would be hungry. I was the leader of the band so I felt responsible for giving them vittles, and that’s another Emerson Brown story, he was snoring along with the rest of them so I decided to…
That about sums him up I guess.
